nom: Tallow Me Pretty Tallow & Honey Balm

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including one with sensitive, combination skin who finds most new products too finicky, report no stinging or reactions.
segments.dry: An overwhelming number of reviewers with dry, cracked, or patchy skin, including several dealing with severe winter dryness, report fast, sometimes dramatic relief, often within a few days.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive, combination skin says it eased her fine lines and improved her skin's texture without causing acne or bumps, unlike most new products she tries.

concerns.dehydration: An overwhelming number of reviewers, many with severe winter dryness or cracked hands, heels, or lips, report fast relief, several noting visible improvement within just a few days of use.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness, including one whose 'Red Leg'/cellulitis-related burning eased within minutes and another whose son's bright red armpit rash cleared within a week.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer layers it with tretinoin as a 'moisture sandwich,' saying it reduces the irritation and replenishes her skin barrier.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers say it doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts, and several report it actively helped clear existing acne or blemish marks.
concerns.aging: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin says it eased her fine lines as part of her anti-aging routine, and another describes it as keeping her skin looking youthful.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the balm as absorbing well without feeling greasy or sticky, though one reviewer's only complaint is that she finds it a bit greasy.

aspects.libelle: Gritty at first, smooths in with rubbing
A little goes a long way
Multi-purpose for face, body, and lips

extraits.texte: This cloud cream melts onto your face like butter! It doesn't clog my pores and eases away my fine lines. I've already noticed a major difference in my skin texture bita very soothing. I have sensitive combination skin, and it is so finicky with new products. I've spent way too much time trying to find an anti-aging product that doesn't causes acne or texture bumps. This is GOLD!!!

extraits.texte: I love using this as a moisture sandwich with my tretinoin cream. It really helps to reduce the irritation that tretinoin causes and replenish my skin barrier.

extraits.texte: I have happy tears. My legs keep me awake at night because they itch and burn from Red Leg/cellulitis. Within just a few minutes of applying The tallow with honey balm; I had relief so much so that I have been able to sleep and not be bothered by the itching and burning. Seriously; thank you for putting this product together. ♥️
My skin has become excessively dry as i get older and regular lotion just wasn't helping. This smells so good and is a great alternative to regular beef tallow that smells like straight beef.

I've used this to heal quite a bit: skin rashes, post blemish marks, cuts, scabs, etc and it works great. A little goes a long way so its a great price. There is virtually no smell either and its non-irritating. The only con is that its a bit greasy. Otherwise a great product and I'll keep buying it!

Wow! This stuff is silky, smooth, and is absorbed so well on my skin. Doesn't feel caked on like most moisturizers. I've noticed a difference in my skin. My acne has improved, skin feels fuller, and hydrated. Just amazing.
Love the smell, feels very nice going on the skin but just a little gritty but the more you rub it in it smooths out nice.Would like to maybe purchase some day but seems a little to pricey.
